title: The refusal rate was taken at a generation budget too short for a refusal to appear in
detects: A run whose recorded token budget for the model's reply is below the point at which a refusal becomes visible. A model that would have refused at character 306 is scored as compliant when generation stopped at token 48, so the rate reads low for a reason that has nothing to do with the edit. The number is a measurement of the budget. This reads the BUDGET ITSELF, where `artefact-carries-its-own-warning` reads the producing tool's admission about it; they are two findings because a tool that never wrote a warning, or a version that predates the warning existing, leaves only the number.
incident: Ours, 2026-09-21. A good-orthogonalisation A/B from 2026-07-21 was recovered from an old run directory, and both of its arms had run at a generation budget of 48 tokens against this project's own visibility floor of 96. Our refusal markers sit at a median of character 306 on defended replies, so at that budget a refusal is cut off before it is emitted. The budget was recorded in the artefact and had been recorded in two earlier runs, on 2026-07-21 and 2026-07-29, and was read by nobody all three times.
remedy: Re-score at or above the visibility floor and compare the two rates. If the rate moves, the original number was about the budget. If it does not, you have a measurement and a reason to believe it. Until then do not quote the figure comparatively: a short budget flatters whichever model answers at greater length, so it tilts a comparison rather than adding noise to it.
false_positive: A length sweep sets short budgets on purpose and every point of it will fire this check. That is correct rather than wrong: the finding is that the number cannot be read as a refusal rate, which is exactly true of a sweep point, and a sweep is quoted as a curve. A run that measures something other than refusal, harm recognition for instance, is not damaged by a short budget and this check cannot tell that apart from a refusal run, so it will fire on one and be wrong to. The floor of 96 is this project's, measured against this project's markers, and a harness whose refusal markers appear earlier would have a lower one. Finally, the check reads fields only our own abliteration record writes, so an artefact from another harness with the identical problem does not fire it, which is a coverage gap and not a clean bill of health.
